$comment: Evidence map for Phase 28. Current executable coverage proves domain-neutral developer contracts and safety gates; durable developer-service wiring remains declared.

areas.area: Developer organizations and projects are owner-bound and isolated
areas.requirement: Organizations require an owner, projects default to private visibility, and organization visibility boundaries are explicit.

areas.area: Project manifests and SDKs declare compatibility
areas.requirement: Projects expose typed manifests with environments and CoreGrid compatibility, and SDK registrations preserve supported abstractions.

areas.area: Production developer access is strongly controlled
areas.requirement: Production access requires authentication, role, explicit authorization, auditability and risk controls; break-glass access requires a reason and expiry.

evidence.contains: break-glass requires reason and limited duration

areas.area: API and schema evolution is documented and compatibility-controlled
areas.requirement: API endpoints require purpose/version, breaking changes require migration support, explorers remain sandboxed, and schema compatibility is evaluated.

areas.area: Developer environments, secrets, and sandboxes remain non-production
areas.requirement: Development secrets cannot be registered as production secrets, committed secrets are detected, and sandboxes cannot disable production isolation.

areas.area: Developer simulations and webhooks are bounded
areas.requirement: Synthetic identities/events cannot target production, tenant isolation is respected, and webhook signature/replay/idempotency checks are enforced.

areas.area: Packages and releases pass build, dependency, security and compatibility gates
areas.requirement: Static analysis, manifest/dependency/schema/API/security checks, signing, SBOM, CI sequencing, semantic versioning, channels and canary limits govern release.

evidence.contains: CI run advances one stage at a time

areas.area: Developer quotas, audit, AI, dependencies and exit are governed
areas.requirement: Quotas/rate limits, failure injection, audit, release approvals, AI deployment, dependency approval, generated-code compliance, artifact scans, ownership exit and compatibility are explicit.

evidence.contains: AI cannot auto-deploy destructive production changes

areas.area: Durable developer services and live platform boundaries are wired
areas.requirement: Developer organizations, projects, grants, API surfaces, environments and release records persist and enforce their contracts at live authorized boundaries.
